summary: Comprehensive backend + smoke frontend testing for DIGITAL EDUCATION PROGRAM. Wrote 43 pytest cases covering auth (5 roles), RBAC, year separation, students CRUD, bulk upload workflow (validate + errors + import + history + export), attendance sheet/save/low, courses+assign+progress update, promotion, masters CRUD, users, audit logs, 16 reports + Excel/PDF exports, dashboard KPIs and year comparison. All 43 tests pass (100%). Frontend smoke: admin dashboard shows 13 KPI cards + charts, global year selector present, Students/Reports pages have all required data-testids, Student role redirects to /my and cannot open /students or /users, mobile bottom nav (5 items) renders at 390x844.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 because audit records had nested MongoDB ObjectId inside new_value (insert_one mutates dict adding _id). FIXED by stripping _id recursively in audit() writes and read endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: One KPI 'kpi-avg-progress-pct' data-testid not found (card exists in UI as 'AVG COURSE PROGRESS' but different testid used). Verify testid naming matches spec.

issues: 'DIGITAL EDUCATION PROGRAM' text visually overlaps between the sidebar logo/title and top-bar title (see screenshot). Consider hiding sidebar brand text or reducing width.

action_items: Verify data-testid naming for the avg-progress KPI card (spec says kpi-avg-progress-pct).
Fix visual overlap between sidebar brand and top-bar app title on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: audit() previously stored raw dicts returned from insert_one (which motor mutates to include _id ObjectId) leading to unreadable audit logs. Now sanitized.
PENDING dict for bulk upload is in-memory only — will lose validation state on backend restart; consider persisting to a short-TTL collection for robustness.
core.py's audit() stores full user objects in reports/dashboards but that is okay; only nested _id was the issue.
server.py uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials — works but permissive; consider tightening in production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed students/users/blocks; upload_history rows also created (safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs from repo root: `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. All 43 tests currently pass. Frontend only smoke-tested; deeper interactive testing (form dialogs, chart rendering, promotion UI, bulk upload UI end-to-end) not yet exercised. Audit-log 500 bug was fixed by adding _strip_mongo_ids helper in core.py.
rca of the issue: GET /api/audit-logs returned 500. RCA: audit() persisted new_value/old_value dicts returned from motor insert_one, which mutates the passed dict to contain an ObjectId _id. When the audit-logs endpoint tried to serialize these nested _id ObjectIds, FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed. Mitigation: added _strip_mongo_ids helper in core.py that recursively drops _id keys from dicts/lists; audit() now sanitizes old_value/new_value on write, and audit-logs endpoint also sanitizes on read for backward compatibility with existing records.
